title: Pots

infobox.Crafting Materials: Pot shard x3, x4, x5, Charcoal resin x1

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Pots are decorative furniture pieces that can be used to store items. They cannot be used for planting.
Pots are crafted from Pot shards dropped from destroying Ancient pots and Charcoal resin dropped from Scorched Trees.
They do not require any station to be built.

Pots are crafted from Pot shards dropped from destroying Ancient pots and Charcoal resin dropped from Scorched Trees.
